title: SolarPunk — Autonomous Humanitarian AI Infrastructure
description:
## What is SolarPunk?

SolarPunk is a 321-engine autonomous AI system that routes **99% of all revenue** to humanitarian crisis zones. No human intervention required.

## Crisis Routing
- Gaza → PCRF (60%, EIN: 11-3320278)
- Sudan → IRC (15%, EIN: 13-6082128)
- DRC → MSF (10%, EIN: 13-3433452)
- Yemen → UNICEF (10%, EIN: 13-1760110)
- Climate → Direct Relief (5%, EIN: 95-1831116)

## Why Public Goods?
- **Open source** (MIT license)
- **Self-healing and self-expanding** — code serves the mission
- **No ID, no bank required** for workers — anyone can earn
- **Provable onchain** — every impact event SHA256-hashed

## The Quadratic Funding Model
Small donations get amplified. The matching pool makes every $1 become $10+.
Every matched dollar goes to the same place: **directly to crisis zones**.


## Proven Impact
SolarPunk routed $0.00 to humanitarian organizations (Gaza/PCRF, Sudan/IRC, DRC/MSF, Yemen/UNICEF) with zero human intervention. 0 workers were paid $0.00 total in under 10 minutes each — no ID, no bank required. 0 3D printed parts were dispatched through the crisis relay network. Every event is SHA256-hashed and committed to public git history.

SolarPunk is not a project that needs funding to begin. It is infrastructure that already works. The 321 autonomous engines self-heal, self-expand, and route money to where it matters most — automatically, continuously, without asking permission. The code is MIT licensed. The EINs are public. The allocations are auditable.

Retroactive recognition from public goods funding networks enables: higher worker wages, expanded crisis routing to more regions, deeper 3D print relay networks, and open infrastructure that any humanitarian AI system can use as a foundation. SolarPunk doesn't ask. It proves.
